title: Tech View group headers show grip, arrow, avatar, name, pin and count
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" (on another site: the location named in the test run).
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "DC-08-tech-view-group-headers-light-1440.png" and "DC-08-tech-view-collapsed-light-1440.png" attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and the rank numbers in the pictures are sample data.
  • Technicians "ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Ines" (with a profile photo) and "ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Jon" (no photo) are active at this location, and no technician is pinned in your Tech View.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Group Header" has Approved work orders "C590117-U1" led by "ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Ines" and "C590117-U2" led by "ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Jon", and an Estimate, unit "C590117-U3", with no lead technician.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Tech View" shown, "Search" holding "ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Group Header", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, density "Regular".
  • If any record named above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the "Unassigned" group header from left to right.
  2. Look at "ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Jon"'s group header from left to right.
  3. Look at the avatar in "ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Ines"'s group header.
  4. Hover the number at the right of "ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Ines"'s group header.
  5. Hover the avatar in "ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Jon"'s group header.
  6. Click the pin in "ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Jon"'s group header.
  7. Click the arrow in "ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Ines"'s group header.
  8. Click the same arrow again.
  9. Click the density button and choose "Compact".
  10. Click the density button and choose "Comfortable".
  11. Click the pin in "ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Jon"'s group header to unpin it.
custom_expected:
Step 1: a thin down-pointing arrow, a round light-grey avatar with a grey outline person icon, the word "Unassigned" in dark semibold text, a short grey divider, a clipboard outline icon and the count, as in the picture. No six-dot grip and no pin.

Step 2: the six-dot grip, the arrow, a light-grey circle with the initials in dark grey (a little darker than in the design picture, not a solid blue circle with white initials), the name in dark slate semibold text about the size of the row text, a grey outline pin that shows without hovering, the divider, the clipboard icon and the count.

Step 3: the avatar is the technician's round photo.

Step 4: a dark tooltip opens above the number and does not cover any column header label.

Step 5: the browser's plain name tip shows "ZZAUTOTEST C590117 Jon".

Step 6: the pin turns blue, as on a pinned Board View column header.

Step 7: the group closes and its arrow points right, as in the collapsed picture.

Step 8: the group opens again and the arrow points down.

Step 9: the headers are shorter and their avatars smaller; the names keep the same size.

Step 10: the headers are taller and their avatars larger; the names keep the same size.

Step 11: the pin is grey again.
